inlines.v: NORTH'ERLY, adjective Being towards the north, or nearer towards the north than to any other cardinal point. [We use this word and northern with considerable latitude.] NORTH'ERLY, adverb 1. Towards the north; as, to sail northerly 2. In a northern direction; as a northerly course. 3. Proceeding from a northern point.
